components.name: WindowRange
components.doc: A time window over a live area chart. Drag either edge of the frame to resize it, drag inside to pan and flick to let it coast, or press outside to glide it there. The chart outside the window fades back; inside, a floating lens with a thick bezel replays the selected slice at full color, cropped 1:1 out of the plot. The start, end and length readouts roll to their new values. New data morphs the chart in place, and with `live` a dot pulses on the latest point.

members.name: value
members.doc: Domain value the tick points at.

members.name: label
members.doc: Short label, such as a month name.

members.name: data
members.doc: The series behind the window, one number per point, spread evenly from min to max. Pass a new array to morph the chart to it.

members.name: value
members.doc: Controlled window as [start, end] in domain units. Pair with onValueChange. A new value from outside glides the frame there.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Starting window when uncontrolled. Defaults to the last quarter of the domain.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Runs on every change while dragging, coasting after a flick or pressing keys.

members.name: onValueCommit
members.doc: Runs once the window has settled after a drag, a flick or a key.

members.name: min
members.doc: Start of the domain, for example day 0.

members.name: max
members.doc: End of the domain. Defaults to data.length - 1.

members.name: step
members.doc: Both ends snap to this step, counted from min.

members.name: largeStep
members.doc: How far Page Up, Page Down and Shift with an arrow move an edge or the window. Defaults to a tenth of the domain.

members.name: minSpan
members.doc: The narrowest window as end minus start, in domain units.

members.name: maxSpan
members.doc: The widest window as end minus start, in domain units. Defaults to the whole domain.

members.name: format
members.doc: Formats the start and end readouts and the spoken values.

members.name: formatSpan
members.doc: Formats the middle readout from end minus start. Pass null to hide it.

members.name: ticks
members.doc: Labels under the chart, such as the first day of each month.

members.name: label
members.doc: Names the group and prefixes the names of the start, window and end sliders.

members.name: live
members.doc: Pulses a dot on the latest point to show that the series is still arriving.

members.name: accent
members.doc: Any CSS color for the frame and the line. Defaults to the theme ink color for the frame and the first chart series for the line.

members.name: height
members.doc: Height of the chart in px, from 64 to 240.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Dims the control and ignores pointer and keys.
